source_note: 数据来自开源客户端 Mod SkyHanni 的 SkyHanni-REPO 仓库 constants/regexesModern.json (用于解析游戏内文本的正则表达式常量),已去除正则语法/颜色码还原成干净模板文本, 可信度高于 Wiki 摘要,但未逐条在游戏内截图核对,verified_ingame 仍为 false。
note: 已核实:出现在挖矿事件 Mithril Gourmand(矿区限时活动)中,玩家需要喂食“美味秘银”(Tasty Mithril,挖秘银矿石时小概率掉落)给他,累计喂食数量决定活动奖励等级。计分板提示 'Give Tasty Mithril to Don!' 里的 'Don' 就是他的简称,见 ScoreBoard/Mining_Sidebar.json 已同步更新。

messages.raw: §fTHIS ISN'T WHAT I ASKED FOR! BRING §lTASTY MITHRIL§f TO ME NOW!
messages.text: THIS ISN'T WHAT I ASKED FOR! BRING TASTY MITHRIL TO ME NOW!

segments.text: THIS ISN'T WHAT I ASKED FOR! BRING
segments.zh: 这根本不是我点的! 马上给我端

messages.raw: §fDISGUSTING! I'M GONNA GET YOU FIRED FOR FEEDING ME THIS GARBAGE!
messages.text: DISGUSTING! I'M GONNA GET YOU FIRED FOR FEEDING ME THIS GARBAGE!
messages.zh: 恶心! 就凭你给我端这种垃圾,我要让你被开除!

messages.text: EWWW WHAT IS THIS?
messages.zh: 呃啊,这是什么玩意儿?

messages.zh: 我饿了

messages.text: BRING ME EDIBLE MITHRIL
messages.zh: 给我上能吃的秘银

messages.text: THIS OLD MITHRIL IS STALE! DON'T EVER FEED THIS TO ME AGAIN!
messages.zh: 这秘银都放陈了! 以后别再拿这种东西喂我!

messages.text: I FORGOT TO BRING A SNACK
messages.zh: 我忘了带点心

messages.text: 0/10, WOULD NOT RECOMMEND, TAKING TOO LONG
messages.zh: 0/10 分,绝不推荐,上菜太慢

messages.zh: 我要在 MINEADVISOR 上给这地方打差评

messages.text: I WANT TO SPEAK TO YOUR MANAGER

messages.zh: 看着可真不错

messages.text: I MIGHT JUST STAY HERE FOREVER THEN
messages.zh: 那我干脆在这儿待一辈子算了

messages.text: DO YOU EVEN KNOW WHO I AM

messages.text: MY FATHER WILL HEAR ABOUT THIS

messages.text: WHY IS THIS TAKING SO LONG

messages.text: I DON'T HAVE ALL DAY, I ONLY WANT THE BEST LOOKING MITHRIL PIECES!

messages.context: 玩家给 Don Expresso 喂食“美味秘银”过量后的反应
messages.text: I DON'T FEEL SO GOOD...
messages.gloss: 这句是流行文化梗(《复仇者联盟3》里蜘蛛侠灰飞烟灭前的台词 'I don't feel so good'),中文沿用该梗的通行译法。
messages.zh: 我感觉不太好……
messages.raw: §fI DON'T FEEL SO GOOD...
§fPLEASE NO, NO MORE. I'M STUFFED!
messages.text: PLEASE NO, NO MORE. I'M STUFFED!
messages.zh: 别、别了,我吃不下了,撑死我了!
